resources.string: Your vault, only with you
VettID keeps your messages, connections and most important secrets in a vault that only you can open.
Your keys stay on this phone and in your vault\'s sealed enclave.
You need a VettID membership: the account site gives you a code to set up your vault here.

A vault has exactly one app, which holds its credential. Another phone is that app. Move VettID to this phone from there, or recover the vault if that phone is lost.
Still have the other phone?
Move VettID with a direct transfer: the other phone shows a code, this phone scans it, and you approve there with your PIN and credential password. No waiting.

Backup on (recommended)
Your vault keeps a copy sealed to it and to your password. If you lose this phone, a recovery restores your vault on a new one.
Backup off
Your credential lives only on this phone. No copy exists anywhere else.
No recovery without this phone
If this phone is lost, broken, reset or replaced without a transfer, your vault cannot be recovered. It can only be deleted and replaced by a new one, and everything in it is lost.

Recovering or moving your vault

First update VettID from where you installed it and try again: your PIN was not counted as wrong.

If that does not help, recover your vault. Start a recovery on the account site, install a current version of VettID (on this phone after removing this one, or on another phone) and choose "I lost my phone: recover my vault" on its first screen, then scan or type the recovery code. A recovery takes %1$s and needs your PIN and your credential password.

Moving your vault to a new phone directly is not possible while this phone cannot open it.

Messages from this phone to your vault keep being refused. If you moved VettID to another phone, this one may have been replaced. Enter your PIN to check with your vault.

Start over on this phone?

There you can recover again, use a setup code or move VettID from your old phone.\n\nThe recovery itself is not cancelled by this: it stays open until you cancel it on the account site or it expires, and its code cannot be used a second time. To recover with this phone later, cancel it there and start a new recovery. Your vault is not changed.
